title: 2000 Upper Deck MVP #84 Randy Moss Minnesota Vikings Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This sports trading card features Randy Moss, a former Minnesota Vikings player who went on to play for the National Football League (NFL). The card is from the 2000 Upper Deck MVP set and has a card number of 93. It is a base set card and is perfect for any football fan or sports trading card collector.

The card is in great shape and has not been autographed. It is a must-have for any Vikings or NFL fan. Add it to your collection today!
